```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Decent living energy (DLE) describes the minimum amount of energy needed to live well.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Decent living standards (DLS) traces the material requisites of a good life.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Aspects of decent living standards include access to durable, modern, affordable, energy efficient and climate resilient housing.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Aspects of decent living standards include ready access to day-to-day technologies that improve well-being, including refrigeration, washing machines, and multi-modal transportation.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Aspects of decent living standards include access to electrified public transit.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Sufficiency is far more materially generous than many degrowth opponents assume.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Degrowth is ecofeminist, centering the safe reproduction of life on Earth in perpetuity.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"For capitalism, reproductive labor—the unpaid work of caring for others—is valued only insofar as it is exploitable in market exchange.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Socialist feminism highlights that reproductive labor is never valuable in itself for capitalism.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Many forms of labor are intrinsically valuable and ought to be socially recognizable as such.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"No socially appropriate form of value is compatible with the accumulation of capital wealth.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Reproduction requires an end to the arbitrary bifurcation between reproductive, unpaid, women-dominated care work and conventional, paid, male-dominated, and privileged labor that depends on the former to exist.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
